name: ai-coding-fall2026-slides
description: Slides for CS 7180: Vibe Coding - AI-Assisted Software Engineering

scripts.build:workshop: ln -sfn ../css workshop/css && ln -sfn ../js workshop/js && reveal-md workshop --static dist-workshop && cp workshop/index.html dist-workshop/index.html && node workshop/build-handouts.mjs && rm -f dist-workshop/facilitator-guide.html dist-workshop/README.html dist-workshop/handouts/README.html
scripts.serve:workshop: npm run build:workshop && echo '\nWorkshop preview → http://localhost:8890/\n' && python3 -m http.server 8890 --directory dist-workshop
scripts.deploy:workshop: npm run build:workshop && ssh johnguerra 'mkdir -p /var/www/lectures/aiCoding_workshop' && rsync -auz --partial --delete -e ssh dist-workshop/ johnguerra:/var/www/lectures/aiCoding_workshop/

author: John Alexis Guerra Gómez
